note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Both rooms are identical except the ONE supplied state: A 'authorization requested, as supplied' (● sign, ● pin on the petition) and B 'decision supplied, as supplied' (◆ sign; the decision's placeholder sheet, content never shown, laid with its ◆ pin in the prior-examination tray's other slot) — equal weight. In both rooms the participant carries the petition along the same configured path to the prior-examination tray, a neutral two-slot tray marked only by a plain tab. The stations are abstract and fictional, of the same size on one row (no rank, level or hierarchy); the path is ONLY the supplied sequence. No criterion, threshold, time limit, outcome (granted / refused / admitted) or jurisdiction is drawn; neither state is preferred. Brief fields: decisions (the petition and the supplied decision placeholder), routes, outcomes (the two headers' states), scenarioA, scenarioB, changedFact, sharedFacts and comparisonLabels are editable. OMITTED brief field: grounds — grounds of a request would add legal content (criteria) the comparison must not draw.
